body:
Deal: Beats Studio Pro ANC Over Ear Wireless Headphones $264 (RRP $479) + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi

[xyron] How did you manage to post this without heeding all the blaring warnings that the OzBargain bot hits you with about "price in title" and other identifying details???
[keji] How odes this compare to te he airpods 3 pro…. aside from the price
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] it's a good deal isnt it? cheapest so far I think.
seems like ozb not a big fan of beats. but reviews say this studio one is their most best sounding headphone so far.
and includes apple's m1 chip? ok so it doesn't have it, but apparently lots of apple chip features supported. one touch pairing, icloud device sync, hey siri, find my. so it's a good option for apple users who don't want to spend $$$ for the Airpods max.
[chrig] That’s what I thought too. They look good as well.
[siemic] Not as comfy as max, I got a pair of these for my wife, and it feels extremely tight on the head. She's gotten used to it, but I can't wear it for longer than 10 min. Even after some months of use, it still feels tight, but now doesn't really sit on the ears right. It seems on par with a JBL headset in terms of build quality. Sound quality is great though; I can't hear a difference from Airpods max tbh. Disregarding apple features, if you want a great headset cheaper than airpods max, just get XM6.
